acceptance_predicates.description: The operator runner launches the public ASB command as a session leader with the PTY slave as its controlling terminal and foreground process group.
The runner sets and verifies a nonzero operator-sized terminal window before the interactive launch.
Readiness, quit input, process exit, output, and cleanup are explicitly bounded and deterministic.
Timeout and malformed-output paths terminate and reap only the fixture process tree and close all PTY resources without survivors.
Exact paired asb tui install followed by bare asb tui passes through the repaired runner; direct-binary or mock success is insufficient.
Qualification remains credential-free, provider-network denied, exact-identity bound, and emits only privacy-safe receipt data.

definition_of_done: Signed+DCO implementation is independently reviewed and merged on protected asb-tui main.
Focused controlling-PTY, window-size, interaction, cleanup, JSON/human, and privacy tests pass at the reviewed head.
Required exact-head and post-merge hosted checks are terminal green.
AR-1654 is requalified against the paired repaired ASB and asb-tui heads.

outputs.description: Bounded faithful controlling-PTY operator-journey fixture and regression coverage.

gates.description: Controlling-terminal, foreground-group, nonzero-size, quit, timeout cleanup, output, and privacy tests pass.
Exact paired installed public command journey passes after the ASB launcher repair.
Exact reviewed head and post-merge required CI pass.
